scope: First-stage multi-source optical self-supervision with A (spatial rectangle reconstruction) and B1 (native visible-band holdout reconstruction) only. B2 cross-source pairing, cross-satellite geometry calibration, JEPA and EnMAP admission are outside E0.

model.notes: Architecture is unchanged from the audited Participation path: continuous SRF -> SRF+log(GSDx)+log(GSDy) -> shared hypernetwork -> per-band 3x3 dynamic convolution -> single-round participation merge -> native and merged tokens -> shared local/global Transformer. No satellite embedding, no PSF, no recursive merge, no band-count unification.
model.execution_evidence: Cell-indexed exact readout measured on a real four-band 128-pixel Sentinel-2 B1 view: 55.5 s -> 2.6 s (21.7x) with identical support (16384), identical token count (43674) and NMSE 1.6388746404 vs 1.6388746416 (relative difference 7.5e-10); A view 4.4 s -> 2.9 s with NMSE 2.39315393 in both. Same native cells, same union-overlap weights, same supervision support, same loss normalization; no model, token or supervision change.
model.local_batch_evidence: Bounded eight-observation real A+B1 update: local batch 1024 is 1.79x the local-64 baseline (11.23 s vs 20.10 s median of three repeats), peak allocated memory unchanged (815 MB vs 798 MB), gradient relative L2 8.6e-8 and loss relative difference 4.6e-8 against the baseline, identical support counts and token counts. 256/512 give 1.60x/1.62x. Packed local output (1.09x) and the matrix A readout (1.04x, memory 697 MB) are not adopted because their gain is inside noise on this bounded case set. Observation microbatch 1 stays the default: 2/4/8 give 1.01-1.04x with 1.6x/2.8x/4.9x peak memory.

roles.TRAIN: frozen member pool only; never VAL
roles.VAL: fixed validation panel only; never a training input

data.merge_curve_status: preflight-confirmed coefficients reused unchanged; formal freeze is an E0 approval item
data.statistics: release statistics.json, scope TRAIN-only, 43 instrument:band keys

sampling.source_rule: equal 4+4 slots for the S2 and Landsat families, eight distinct members per logical update, hash-ranked without replacement within the frozen TRAIN pool

mask_rule.size_rounding: nearest integer patch count, clipped to observation patch layout

sampling.P_rule: P = P_values[logical_update % 2]; P is task mask and physical grid context only and never changes Merge membership
sampling.B1_rule: half single-hidden and half multi-hidden; multi-hidden hidden count uniform over 2..C-1; at least one real input band always remains; target bands never enter the Encoder and only their SRF conditions the Decoder

pool_rule.rationale: Full-attention Transformer cost grows quadratically in tokens. The release contains S2 10-band scenes up to 2769x2769 native pixels (estimated 32.5M tokens, physically untrainable in the declared budget). The cap is a counted data rule frozen into the recipe hash: 586 of 7395 TRAIN members (all S2 10-band, native side >128) are excluded and reported, not dropped silently. Lifting the cap needs a compute-budget or crop protocol decision.

validation.hierarchy: A: cases -> observation -> source -> equal sources. B1: single-hidden mean and multi-hidden mean at 1/2 each, multi-hidden an equal mean over hidden counts 2..C-1 after the mean over cases within each count, then observation, then source, then equal sources.
validation.fixed: fixed VAL members, fixed masks, fixed SRF/data version, fixed panel; no dynamic member or mask replacement and no silent source renormalization
validation.forbidden: B2 cases, VAL fitted statistics, missing-source reweighting, nonfinite placeholder values
validation.execution_note: fixed panel is collected with the same cell-indexed readout as training; forward only, no gradients

control.checkpoint: one complete checkpoint per logical update with full optimizer, scheduler, RNG and runner early-stop state
control.budget_status: candidate; resource_limit and early_stop are E0 approval items

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.groups: decay on weights, no decay on bias and LayerNorm
optimizer.selection_status: user-selected AdamW for the historical pilot; E0 re-approval is an E0 item

research_status.gate_block: independent E0 ids only; historical A/B1/B2 gates stay closed and unchanged
out_of_scope: B2 pair admission and cross-source registration

curriculum.implementation: accumulate_adaptive_joint uses tasks.curriculum(logical_update, duration=2000); A weight 1.00->0.25 and B weight 0.25->1.00 through a smoothstep
curriculum.status: CANDIDATE_PENDING_APPROVAL: inherited from the historical A/B curriculum and not yet approved for A+B1
